title: 第25张 定名清涧花 灵花解沉伤第26章 溪涧惊灵现 血战覆玄龟
lines: 短暂歇息过后，腹间空乏之感缓缓袭来，方才二人在溪间合力捕获的数尾肥硕溪鱼，恰好能用来解决今日午间吃食。
罗止正缓缓直起身形，目光从容扫过周遭林木，神色平静，缓声开口道：“先收集些干柴生火，将溪鱼烤熟，填饱肚子，再继续往谷涧深处探索。”
李紫云微微颔首，眉眼柔和，动作轻缓地站起身，轻声应道：“好，就按你说的来。”
她抬手将刚采到的清涧凝络花，细心收进腰间储物袋内妥善存放。
随后二人分头行动，罗止正步入周边林间，弯腰捡拾散落的干枯枯枝；李紫云留在青石附近，俯身收拢地面干燥朽木与易燃干草。
晨雾尽数散去，林间枯枝早已风干，不过片刻，两人便收集妥当，将一堆粗细合适的柴火，整齐码放在空地之上。
罗止正屈膝蹲下身，单手探入衣侧裤兜，指尖摸索片刻，取出一枚小巧的防水打火机。他指尖捏紧机壳，神情从容，拇指轻轻一拨，咔哒一声轻响，一簇明亮稳定的火苗骤然燃起。
他手腕微倾，动作沉稳，将跳动的火苗凑近枯枝缝隙，干燥木枝瞬间被引燃，小火苗缓缓蔓延攀升，暖黄火光轻轻晃动，淡淡的烟火气息，慢慢在幽静谷涧之中弥散开来。
李紫云缓步走到溪岸边上，抬手直接从腰间取出贴身佩戴的灵匕。她神色专注，握着锋利的匕身，垂首蹲在溪水边，专心处理起溪鱼。
灵匕刃口锋利，轻快划开鱼身，利落刮去细鳞，剖开鱼腹剔除内里杂质，再借着潺潺流水反复冲洗干净，动作细致娴熟，很快就将所有溪鱼打理完毕。
随后她捡起篝火旁堆放的细木枝，手握灵匕，动作利落将树枝一头削尖。指尖灵巧发力，用削好的尖木枝，逐条将处理干净的溪鱼稳稳串牢。她缓缓直起身形，步履轻缓走到篝火旁，眼眸微微抬起，神色温婉柔和，轻声开口道：“柴火已经燃稳，你来负责烤鱼吧。”
罗止正抬眸接过串着溪鱼的尖木枝，手臂轻抬，稳稳架在篝火上方。他神色悠然，双手慢慢转动木枝，让鱼肉全方位均匀受热，语气平淡地缓缓回道：“交给我便可，稍等片刻就能食用。”
火苗轻轻舔舐鲜嫩鱼肉，油脂缓缓渗出，落在木柴上发出细碎滋滋轻响。诱人的鱼肉鲜香缓缓弥漫林间，混着草木清息，格外勾人食欲。
二人一左一右围坐篝火两侧，溪流叮咚作响，木柴噼啪轻燃。
罗止正侧头看向身旁的李紫云，唇角噙着一抹浅淡笑意，语气带着几分温和调侃，慢慢开口道：“没想到某人处理鱼肉，手法竟这般熟手利落。”
李紫云闻言耳尖微微泛红，目光落向跳动的火光，神色安静，语气轻缓地低声回道：“以前爸妈不在家的时候，一日三餐，一直都是我自己煮饭打理。”
火光悠悠摇曳，映在两人脸颊，添上一层暖融融的薄晕。
罗止正指尖不停，缓缓转动手中木枝，任由火苗细细炙烤鱼肉，目光随意落在跳动的火焰上，语气放得平缓柔和，轻声开口道：“原来如此，难怪做起这些琐事这般熟练。”
李紫云指尖轻轻摩挲着衣角，神色略带几分怅然，垂着眼帘，语气平静释然，缓缓说道：“无人相伴的日子居多，早就习惯一个人操持这些琐事。”
鱼肉渐渐烤至金黄焦嫩，表层微微焦脆，内里肉质紧实饱满，浓郁的鲜香愈发醇厚，不断萦绕在空气里。
罗止正鼻尖轻嗅，神色放松，唇角微扬，语气淡淡开口道：“差不多已经烤熟，可以吃了。”
他停下转动木枝的动作，小心翼翼将烤好的溪鱼从火上挪开，避免炭火烤焦外皮。
罗止正眉眼温和，动作细致地递出一串色泽最诱人的烤鱼，缓缓开口道：“先给你，趁热吃。”
李紫云抬眸望向他，眼底掠过一丝暖意，伸手轻轻接过木枝，指尖无意间触到对方的指腹，她耳尖又是一热，连忙收回目光，细声开口道：“谢谢。”
说罢，她小口咬下一块鱼肉，外皮焦香，内里鲜嫩，温热的肉香在唇齿间化开，消解了一路奔波带来的疲累。
罗止正随即拿起另一串烤鱼，低头慢慢咀嚼，目光会偶尔悄然掠过身旁少女安静的侧脸。
两人安静享用着烤鱼，没有过多言语，林间只剩溪水流淌与细碎的柴火噼啪声。
待到吃食完毕，李紫云缓缓放下手中木枝，神色恬淡柔和。她抬手抚上腰间储物袋，指尖探入其中，取出先前收好的清涧凝络花，静静托在掌心。
花瓣莹润通透，脉络细腻，萦绕着一缕极淡的清冽灵气，模样格外别致。
李紫云垂眸端详着掌心的花朵，眼底满是好奇，她从未见过此等草木，全然不知这株灵花有何种药效。
她迟疑片刻，抬眸望向身旁的罗止正，轻声问道：“止正，你知道它有什么用处？”
罗止正顺着她的目光看去，仔细打量片刻，神色平淡，缓缓摇头开口道：“不曾见过，也不清楚它的功效。”
李紫云指尖轻轻摩挲着柔软的花瓣，好奇心愈发浓烈，犹豫着轻声提议：“既然碰巧采到，要不……我们试着看看效果？”
罗止正眉头微蹙，神色多了几分谨慎，沉声开口劝阻：“山野奇花品类繁杂，谁也不知是否带有毒性，不能随意入口，太过冒险。”
李紫云心中好奇早已压过顾虑，她抿了抿唇，目光执拗，轻声说道：“我实在太过好奇，还是想试一试，说不定是难得的灵花，能有不错的裨益。”
罗止正见她执意如此，怕她贸然误食伤及自身，沉吟片刻，开口说道：“你别冒险，要试的话，我来就好。”
他顿了顿，语气谨慎补充道：“只摘一片花瓣尝试，用量极少，就算真的带有微毒，也不会有大碍。”
话音落下，罗止正抬手，小心从花上摘下一片单薄的花瓣，缓缓送入口中，静静体会体内的细微变化。
花瓣入口绵柔，带着一缕清冽甘润的淡香，顺着喉间缓缓滑落。
一股温和微凉的药力悄然化开，缓缓游走四肢百骸，细微疏通着体内淤塞的经络，柔和抚平苍龙威压留下的经脉暗伤。
content_en:
After a short rest, the feeling of emptiness in the stomach slowly came over. The few plump creek fish the two of them had just caught together in the stream could just be used for today's lunch meal.
Luo Zhizheng slowly straightened up, his eyes calmly scanning the surrounding trees, his expression calm, and he spoke slowly: "First collect some dry firewood to make a fire, roast the stream fish, fill your stomach, and then continue to explore the depths of the valley."
Li Ziyun nodded slightly, his eyebrows softened, he stood up gently and responded softly: "Okay, I'll do as you say."
She raised her hand and carefully put the newly picked Qingjian Ningluo flowers into the storage bag on her waist for safe storage.
The two then split up. Luo Zhizheng walked into the surrounding forest and bent down to pick up scattered dry branches; Li Ziyun stayed near the bluestone, leaning over to gather dry rotten wood and flammable hay on the ground.
The morning fog had all dispersed, and the dead branches in the forest had long dried. In just a few moments, the two of them collected the firewood and placed a pile of firewood of suitable thickness neatly in the open space.
Luo Zhizheng knelt down, put one hand into his side trouser pocket, fumbled with his fingertips for a moment, and took out a small waterproof lighter. He squeezed the casing tightly with his fingertips, looked calm, flicked it with his thumb, made a soft click, and a bright and stable flame suddenly ignited.
He tilted his wrist slightly and moved calmly, bringing the beating flame close to the gap between the dead branches. The dry wood branches were instantly ignited. The small flames slowly spread and climbed. The warm yellow firelight swayed slightly, and the faint smell of fireworks slowly spread in the quiet valley.
Li Ziyun walked slowly to the bank of the stream, raised his hand and took out the spiritual dagger he wore close to his waist. She looked focused, holding the sharp dagger, squatting by the stream with her head lowered, and concentrated on handling the stream fish.
The edge of the spirit dagger is sharp, and it cuts open the fish body quickly, scrapes off the fine scales neatly, cuts open the belly of the fish and removes the impurities inside, and then rinses it repeatedly with the gurgling water. With careful and skillful movements, all the fish in the stream are quickly taken care of.
Then she picked up the thin wooden branches piled next to the campfire, held the spirit dagger in her hand, and sharpened one end of the branches with neat movements. Using dexterous force with his fingertips, he used sharpened wooden branches to string together the cleaned stream fish one by one. She straightened up slowly, walked gently to the bonfire, raised her eyes slightly, looked gentle and soft, and said softly: "The firewood has been burned steadily, you can be responsible for grilling the fish."
Luo Zhizheng raised his eyes and took the sharp branch with the stream fish strung on it. He gently raised his arm and placed it firmly above the bonfire. With a leisurely look on his face, he slowly turned the wooden branches with his hands so that the fish meat could be evenly heated in all directions. He slowly replied in a calm tone: "Just leave it to me. You can eat it after a while."
The flames gently licked the tender fish meat, and the oil slowly seeped out, falling on the firewood and making a soft sizzling sound. The alluring aroma of fish meat slowly fills the forest, mixed with the fresh breath of vegetation, which is particularly appetizing.
The two of them sat on either side of the bonfire, with the stream tinkling and the firewood crackling and burning softly.
Luo Zhizheng turned his head to look at Li Ziyun beside him, with a faint smile on his lips. His tone was a bit gentle and teasing, and he slowly said: "I didn't expect someone to handle fish with such skill and skill."
The tips of Li Ziyun's ears turned slightly red when he heard this, and his eyes fell on the dancing firelight. His expression was quiet, and he whispered back in a soft tone: "When my parents were not at home, I always cooked and took care of three meals a day."
The firelight swayed slowly, reflecting on the two people's cheeks, adding a thin layer of warmth.
Luo Zhizheng kept his fingertips and slowly turned the wooden branch in his hand, letting the flames roast the fish. His eyes fell on the dancing flames casually. He spoke in a calm and gentle tone and said softly: "I see. No wonder he is so skilled at doing these trivial things."
Li Ziyun's fingertips gently rubbed the hem of his clothes, with a slightly sad look on his face. He lowered his eyes and said in a calm and relieved tone, "I spend most of my time without anyone by my side. I have long been used to taking care of these trivial matters alone."
The fish meat is gradually grilled until golden brown and tender, the surface is slightly crispy, the meat is firm and plump inside, and the rich aroma becomes more mellow and lingers in the air.
Luo Zhizheng sniffed lightly with the tip of his nose, looked relaxed, raised the corners of his lips slightly, and said in a calm tone: "It's almost cooked and ready to eat."
He stopped turning the sticks and carefully moved the grilled fish away from the fire to prevent the charcoal fire from scorching the skin.
Luo Zhizheng's eyebrows were gentle, and he carefully handed out a bunch of grilled fish with the most attractive color, and said slowly: "I'll give it to you first, eat it while it's hot."
Li Ziyun raised her eyes to look at him, with a hint of warmth flashing in her eyes. She stretched out her hand to gently take the wooden branch, and her fingertips accidentally touched the other person's fingertips. The tips of her ears felt hot again. She quickly looked away and said softly: "Thank you."
After that, she took a small bite of a piece of fish. The outside was charred and the inside was tender. The warm aroma of the meat melted between her lips and teeth, which relieved the fatigue caused by traveling all the way.
Luo Zhizheng immediately picked up another skewer of grilled fish, lowered his head and chewed slowly, his eyes occasionally passing over the quiet profile of the girl next to him.
The two of them enjoyed the grilled fish quietly without saying much, and the only sound left in the forest was the flowing stream and the crackling of firewood.
After finishing eating, Li Ziyun slowly put down the wooden branch in his hand, with a calm and gentle expression. She raised her hand to touch the storage bag at her waist, dug her fingertips into it, took out the Qingjian Ningluo flower that she had stored earlier, and held it quietly in the palm of her hand.
The petals are shiny and translucent, with delicate veins, lingering with a very light and refreshing aura, and the appearance is particularly unique.
Li Ziyun lowered her eyes and looked at the flowers in her palm, her eyes full of curiosity. She had never seen such vegetation before, and she had no idea what kind of medicinal effects this spiritual flower had.
She hesitated for a moment, raised her eyes to look at Luo Zhizheng beside her, and asked softly: "Zhizheng, do you know what its use is?"
Luo Zhi was following her gaze and looked at it carefully for a moment. With a calm expression, he slowly shook his head and said, "I've never seen it before, and I don't know its efficacy."
Li Ziyun's fingertips gently rubbed the soft petals, and his curiosity became more and more intense. He hesitated and suggested softly: "Since I happened to pick it, how about... let's try and see the effect?"
Luo Zhizheng frowned slightly, looking a little more cautious, and spoke in a deep voice to dissuade: "There are many kinds of exotic flowers in the mountains, and no one knows whether they are poisonous or not. You cannot eat them casually, it is too risky."
The curiosity in Li Ziyun's heart had long outweighed her worries. She pursed her lips, looked stubbornly, and said softly: "I'm just too curious, so I still want to give it a try. Maybe it's a rare spiritual flower that can be of great benefit."
Seeing that she insisted on doing this, Luo Zhi was afraid that she would accidentally eat it and hurt herself. He pondered for a moment and said, "Don't take risks. If you want to try, I'll do it."
He paused and added in a cautious tone: "Just pick one petal and try it. The dosage is very small. Even if it is slightly poisonous, it won't be a serious problem."
After the words fell, Luo Zhizheng raised his hand, carefully picked a thin petal from the flower, slowly put it into his mouth, and quietly experienced the subtle changes in his body.
The petals are soft at the entrance, with a clear and sweet fragrance, and slowly slide down the throat.
A gentle and slightly cool medicinal power quietly melted away, slowly traveling through the limbs and bones, subtly unblocking the congested meridians in the body, and softly smoothing the dark wounds on the meridians left by the pressure of the blue dragon.
title_en: Chapter 25: Named Qingjian Flower, the spiritual flower relieves serious injuries. Chapter 26: A startling spirit appears in the stream, and a bloody battle overturns the mysterious turtle.
